title: My Son Forged A Dissolution, Sold My $660K Fleet, Sent A $4,500 Check. So I Voided The Sale
description: I spent 32 years as a hospital PT aide and put $133,000 of my pension into a wheelchair van and stairlift company with my son. He forged a dissolution, sold the assets for $660,000, and mailed me a $4,500 armrest check, so I pulled the notarized partnership agreement from a hidden seat base and voided the sale. Now he details vans in coveralls that say Rolled Over My Trust while every rental contract prints his fraud docket number. #Revenge #FamilyBetrayal #MobilityBusiness
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY DISSOLUTION AND SENT ME $4,500
pinned_comment: I put $133,000 of my pension into that business and my son forged a dissolution, sold the $660,000 assets, and mailed me a $4,500 armrest check. What would you do if your own child did that to you? Share your story in the comments.
